items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: MaryLou used to come and play and I used to carry a pair of brushes with me and play a piece of cardboard

ctx.x: Just a private home. And at sunset, there was a little place we'd play in the garden, and MaryLou used to come and play and I used to carry a pair of brushes with me and play a piece of cardboard. So I wasn't thrown out, nobody said no. So that's how I progressed, but I listened to that -- I heard things in Kansas City, and everybody that was
there says the same thing. There aren't enough superlatives to tell you how intense the music was.
